title: matra block input, schema 2.x
description: An input format, `blocks`: headings and paragraphs a caller supplies for a document matra has no reader for. Read by `Input::text(json, Format::Blocks)`, `Input::bytes(json, Some(Format::Blocks))`, and a file read as `blocks`. The same blocks in Rust are `Block::heading` and `Block::paragraph`. Unlike the document schema, this one is closed: matra refuses a block whose `kind` it does not know, and a field it does not know, naming it. The analysed text is the blocks' texts joined by a blank line ("\n\n"), in order, and every span in the resulting document points into it.

Heading.description: A heading, which opens a section at its level.

level.description: 1 for a top-level heading, 2 below it, and so on. 0 is refused: it is the level of a section with no heading.

Paragraph.description: A paragraph of prose, parsed into sentences.
